name: Scroll area
layerWhy: It arranges other parts by space; it keeps no promise to the person of its own.
promise: A region that scrolls within itself and never moves the page.
expectation: A box with its own scroll.
evidence: It is focusable and named, so the keyboard scrolls it too.
context: Long activity, logs, lists inside a panel.
relationships: It belongs to the section around it.
